headline: Jos Buttler's 131 powers England to 4-0 T20 series sweep of India
summary: England claims the top spot in T20 world rankings after a dominant 56-run victory in Southampton, led by a blistering century from Jos Buttler.
details: Jos Buttler smashed 131 runs, including eight sixes, in his first international century in three years to lead England to a 56-run win over India in Southampton.
Buttler and captain Harry Brook, who scored 95 not out, shared an England record T20I partnership of 233 runs, propelling the hosts to a massive total of 257-3.
India's chase was hampered by a delayed start due to traffic issues, but they were eventually restricted to 201-8, with Sam Curran taking 3-36.
Ishan Kishan (56) and Tilak Varma (53) provided resistance, but England's bowling attack ensured a commanding victory and a series whitewash.
The two teams will now move to Birmingham for a three-match one-day international series, which may be the final England campaign for Virat Kohli.
In a other notable event, 15-year-old batting star Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was dropped from the squad for the final match.
caption:
Jos Buttler's 131 and a record-breaking partnership leave India whitewashed 4-0!

Jos Buttler smashed 131 runs, including eight sixes, in his first international century in three years to lead England to a 56-run win over India in Southampton.

Buttler and captain Harry Brook, who scored 95 not out, shared an England record T20I partnership of 233 runs, propelling the hosts to a massive total of 257-3.

India's chase was hampered by a delayed start due to traffic issues, but they were eventually restricted to 201-8, with Sam Curran taking 3-36.

Ishan Kishan (56) and Tilak Varma (53) provided resistance, but England's bowling attack ensured a commanding victory and a series whitewash.

The two teams will now move to Birmingham for a three-match one-day international series, which may be the final England campaign for Virat Kohli.

In a other notable event, 15-year-old batting star Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was dropped from the squad for the final match.

headline: South African footballer Jayden dies shortly after World Cup
summary: The athlete passed away soon after returning home from the tournament, leaving the sports community in shock.
details: South African footballer Jayden has passed away shortly after returning home from the World Cup.
